data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 棋盘前的一步
data.description: 轮到她走棋时，巴泽特拿起棋子停了一会儿，仔细看向棋盘另一端。
data.action: 拿起棋子停了一会儿，仔细看向棋盘另一端
data.promptProse: Sitting at a heavy oak pub table beside a warm peat fireplace, Bazett hovers a carved wooden chess piece above the board, studying her next move with a focused expression. A glass of dark stout rests on the weathered wood, softly lit by the amber hearth glow.
data.animaCaption: At a weathered oak pub table beside a glowing hearth, she holds a carved chess piece poised above the board while studying her next move. Warm firelight flickers across the chessboard, her glass of dark stout, and her intent expression.
